tool.description: Rotate a video clockwise by 90, 180, or 270 degrees and/or flip it horizontally or vertically. Set rotate (0/90/180/270) and/or flip (none/horizontal/vertical); at least one must be active. Provide the video as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref. Note: runs on the standalone page and the CLI (chat ffmpeg is unavailable).

url.description: Video URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

rotate.description: Clockwise rotation in degrees: 0, 90, 180, or 270. Default 0.
